common.lead: How the workshop computer is doing: processor, temperature, memory, storage, power and network.

health.the_system_booted_without_a_clean: The system booted without a clean shutdown (power cut, undervoltage or hang).
health.the_system_s_power_supply_doesn: The system's power supply doesn't deliver 5 V (immediate alert).
health.every_alert_is_also_logged_in: Every alert is also logged in Activity. It alerts when the condition lasts a while (not on a spike), doesn't repeat the same alert within 30 min and notifies when it's back to normal. The phone destination and the main switch are on the Activity page.
health.every_alert_is_also_logged_in_no_activit: It alerts when the condition lasts a while (not on a spike), doesn't repeat the same alert within 30 min and notifies when it's back to normal.
health.the_database_and_its_backups_are: The database and its backups are on the same card: if it fails, both are lost. Plug a USB stick into the system.
health.retries_and_requests_per_minute_come: "Retries" and "requests per minute" come from the system log: to see them, the dsf user needs the systemd-journal group (
health.no_permission_to_read_the_log: no permission to read the log (see note)
health.each_dwc_load_or_reload_opens: Each DWC load or reload opens a session; old ones may stay registered for a while. Several sessions from the same device = open tabs or reloads.
health.undervoltage_the_system_s_power_supply: Undervoltage = the system's power supply doesn't deliver the 5 V it needs (cable or supply). It can cause hangs and restarts.
health.data_from_the_last_time_the: Data from the last time the System service ran: not up to date.
health.waiting_for_the_workshopservice_health: Waiting for the WorkshopService health reader (saludPi)... without it, only CPU / temperature / RAM / storage are shown.
health.data_dsf_already_publishes_adds_no: Data DSF already publishes (adds no load to the system). The charts keep the last hour and aren't cleared when changing pages.
health.waiting_for_dsf_data_machine_model: Waiting for DSF data (machine.model.sbc)... This page needs a Duet with a single-board computer (SBC mode).
health.cpu_hint: Average use of the {cores} cores. Alert from {alert} %, limit {limit} %.
health.temp_hint: System CPU. Alert from {alert} °C; at {limit} °C the system starts slowing down so it does not overheat.
health.ram_hint: {used} in use of {total} ({free} free). Alert from {alert} %, limit {limit} %.
health.bridge_name_hint: To see a name instead of "cliente1": PUENTE NOMBRE in your program or Services > Bridge > Configure
health.database_hint: The one of the System service (SQLite, a single file): activity, power usage and received commands. Checked every 5 minutes. The size is the size of the database file, not of the disk; "unused space inside" is room the database reuses by itself.
health.n_backups_to_be_deleted: {n} backup(s) will be deleted automatically soon: check them in Services.
health.n_rows_bad_date: {n} row(s) with a damaged date (not used in the reports by date). Not serious; report it if the number grows.
health.n_rows_date_repaired: {n} row(s) with the date already repaired (the original value is kept in the database).
health.alert_temp_detail: System CPU at {c} C or more for {s} s.
health.alert_wifi_detail: No WiFi or the router does not answer for {s} s (the alert arrives when the network is back).
health.alert_service_detail: Duet control, web server, plugins or G-code bridge stopped for {s} s.
health.alert_disk_detail: Less than {gb} GB (or {pct} %) free on the system card, or the database goes over {mb} MB.
health.history_this_browser: The charts are drawn by this browser since you opened DWC (up to 1 hour): a new phone or tab sees them empty at first.
health.history_kept_by_service: History kept by the service for {days} days, also seen by new phones and tabs. The latest minutes are live.
health.alerts_read_only: Your role can see the alerts but not change them: a technician or the administrator turns them on.

startup.title: Start-up
startup.state_na: does not apply to your machine
startup.make_tip: Copies the example to the SD card. It never overwrites a file that already exists.
startup.edit_tip: Opens the file in the DWC editor.
startup.hide_tip: Hides this row on this screen. It does not delete anything.
startup.service_tip: It has to be running: it makes the examples and answers the buttons of this plugin.
startup.row_sbc: Duet joined to the Pi (SBC mode)
startup.row_sbc_tip: This screen watches the Pi that is joined to the Duet. A Duet on its own has no Pi to watch.
startup.sbc_none: Duet on its own: no Pi to watch
startup.row_data_tip: The service publishes the temperature, memory, disk and services of the Pi while this screen is open.
startup.data_none: the service delivers no data from the Pi
startup.row_vcgencmd_tip: Only Raspberry Pi boards have this tool. Another single-board computer does not, and that is fine.
startup.vcgencmd_none: not available on this computer (not a Raspberry Pi)
startup.row_network_tip: It measures the signal and whether the router answers. With the Pi on a cable there is no WiFi to measure.
startup.network_router: connected but the router does not answer
startup.network_none: no WiFi (cable or no network): does not apply
startup.row_services_tip: Checks that the bridge that receives the live job over Telnet is running.
startup.assist_tip: Walks you through what is missing, one thing at a time. You can skip what you do not need.
startup.assist_no_action: This cannot be fixed with a file from here. Read the explanation and, when you have it, tap "Check again".
startup.assist_done_ready: Everything you went through is ready.
startup.assist_done_left: {n} left to do. You can start again whenever you like.
startup.create_help_tip: Asks a few questions and builds the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.questions_intro: Answer and I will build the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.err_range: The number is outside the allowed range.
startup.err_chars: Do not use quotes, semicolons or line breaks.
startup.err_pattern: It does not have the expected format. See the help of this field.
startup.warn_moves: {n} line(s) that move the machine were commented out with ";". Check them and remove the ";" only when you are sure and the machine is free.
startup.warn_active: Lines without ";" really run when you use the button.
startup.plan_example: {file} only has the example (all commented). It is replaced by this one, and the previous text is kept in {backup}.
startup.plan_new: {file} already has your configuration and I will not overwrite it. This one will be saved apart as {target}; when you have checked it, rename it in Files > Macros.
startup.verify_ok: Done: the file exists, has active instructions and the plugin already sees it.
startup.verify_new: Saved as {file}. The plugin keeps using the previous file until you swap the names.
startup.verify_comments: {file} was saved, but all its lines are still commented, so the plugin still takes it as an example. That may be what you wanted.
startup.verify_notseen: {file} was saved, but the plugin does not see it as ready yet. Tap "Check again" in a few seconds.
startup.verify_missing: I could not read {file} back. Tap "Check again" to verify it.
startup.verify_fail: It could not be saved ({error}). Nothing was changed.
startup.plan_changed: The file changed while you were answering. Check again what is going to happen and confirm once more.
startup.modal_hint: Tap a card to set it up, or let it walk you through step by step.
startup.modal_sub: Get ready what this plugin needs from your machine
startup.row_sbc_what: Your Duet works together with a Raspberry Pi (SBC mode).
startup.row_sbc_for: This page watches that Pi: its temperature, memory and disk.
startup.row_sbc_missing: Without a Pi there is nothing to watch. The row stays grey and nothing happens.
startup.row_data_what: The data about the Pi that the service publishes while this page is open.
startup.row_data_for: The page draws them as cards and charts.
startup.row_data_missing: The page stays empty. Check that the service is running.
startup.row_vcgencmd_what: A Raspberry Pi tool that measures the voltage and whether the Pi slows itself down because of heat or a weak supply.
startup.row_vcgencmd_for: It is used to warn you if the supply of the Pi does not give it enough.
startup.row_vcgencmd_missing: Nothing happens: only that figure is lost. Other single-board computers do not have it.
startup.row_network_what: The WiFi signal of the Pi and whether the router answers it.
startup.row_network_for: It warns you if the connection drops or is weak.
startup.row_network_missing: You do not find out about WiFi drops. With the Pi on a cable this measure does not apply.
startup.row_services_what: The program of the Pi that receives G-code over Telnet for the live job.
startup.row_services_for: Without it a live job cannot be sent. Duet's own services (DCS, DWS, DPS) are in the table of this page.
startup.row_services_missing: It is stopped: start it on the Services page. If you never installed it this row does not show and it is only needed for the live job.
